mapper.select: SELECT task.* FROM wf_task task INNER JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.instance_id = task.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND instance.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.proxy_user_id = #{userId} AND task.status = 'TODO' AND (instance.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR instance.process_no LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
